learning_outcomes.text: Knows about the types of material failures.
Knows about the mechanisms of material failures.
Is able to solve failure problems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction: definition, classification of failure of materials, procedures for determining failures.
Mechanical behavior of materials: overload fracture behavior of tensile, torsion, bending and fatigue samples, state of stresses: principle stresses,
Plane stress-plane strain conditions, stress concentration, types of fracture, crack propagation, ductile and brittle fracture.
Identification of crack origins on fracture surfaces, effect of temperature and strain rate on the material behavior, thermal expansion and thermal st
Causes of failures: defective material, faulty design, inappropriate material selection, faulty manufacturing, construction and assembly.
Weld defects, wrong heat treatment, residual stresses, hot and cold tearing.
Wearing of components, overload or unforeseen loading conditions, inadequate maintenance or improper repairing, abnormal operating temperatures, sever
Wearing of components, overload or unforeseen loading conditions, inadequate maintenance or improper repairing, abnormal operating temperatures, sever
Micro fracture mechanisms: slip, cleavage, twinning, mixed mechanism of fracture, tearing, intergranular separation, fatigue fracture.
Environmentally assisted fracture, comparison of fractographs, and correlation of micro and macrofractographic features.
Types of wear and wear mechanisms, analysis of wear failures. Oxidation and corrosion: types of corrosion.
Prevention of corrosion, analysis of corrosion failures, decreasing of zinc, Hydrogen embrittlement, graphitization of cast iron.
Case studies: pressure vessels and pipings, broken automobile components,
Case studies: turbine blades, steel punches, welded components, analyses of welded components
